question: Umbuzo
defaultDirections: Khetha impendulo ocinga ukuba iphendula umbuzo. Xa ugqibile, cinezela {checkAnswer}. Uza kufumana ingxelo ebonisa ukuba impendulo yakho ichanekile na kwaye uqhubeke njani.
relatedContentDescription: Oku kwenza indawo esongiweyo yomxholo onxulumene nalo mbuzo kwaye ihlala iboniswa
hintDescription: Oku kuboniswa ukuba umsebenzisi uyiphosile impendulo
evidenceDescription: Oku kuboniswa ukuba umsebenzisi uyifumene ichanekile impendulo
crosswordDirections: Chwetheza unobumba omnye kwisikwere ngasinye esimhlophe. Izitshixo zeentolo zihamba phakathi kwezikwere. Khetha isikwere kwakhona, okanye ucinezele Space, ukutshintsha phakathi kwecala nezantsi. Khetha isikhokelo ukutsiba uye kwigama laso. Xa ugqibile, cinezela {checkAnswer}.
noWords: Le phazili yamagama ayinawo amagama okwangoku.
addWords: Yongeza amagama nezikhokelo kuseto ukwakha iphazili. Igridi yenzelwa wena.
answerKey: Isitshixo seempendulo. Abafundi abaze bazibone ezi nobumba.
unplacedHelp: La magama akakwazanga ukufakwa, ngoko abafundi abazukuwabona. Tshintsha igama ukuze labelane ngonobumba nelinye igama, okanye ulisuse.
